settings.title: build
settings.body: Six weeks in the workshop: frame layout, mitring, structural bonding and finishing — real manufacturing, taught by hand.

settings.body: Portfolio work towards OCN London’s bespoke Level 2, Workshop Skills and Sustainable Manufacturing.

settings.title: family visit day
settings.body: The finished balance bike is presented by the Maker to their own child — and goes home with them.

sq ft dedicated workshop at our flagship site

settings.why_body_2: Ministry of Justice research shows that people in prison who maintain family ties are 39% less likely to reoffend (Lord Farmer Review, 2017). And with just 20% of prison-leavers in work six weeks after release nationally (MoJ, 2025), the skills matter as much as the bond. Build to Bond is built around that evidence: a six-week course where the skills are real, the qualification is recognised, and the finish line is a stronger family bond.
settings.sites_body: Build to Bond is established across four UK prison sites, at different delivery stages — with a self-delivery model that trains prison staff and peer instructors to run the workshop.
settings.sites_partner: Delivered under direct contracts with HMPPS and private operators
